title: Built a $29/month alternative to paying $300+/month for Bloomberg signals. Here's exactly what it outputs.
author: Specialist_Kick_9763
selftext:
Bloomberg Terminal: $24,000/year. Motley Stock Advisor: $199/year but the "buy" recommendations come with no entry price, no stop-loss, nothing actionable.

I built AlphaInsight AI because I wanted something in the middle  -  institutional-grade structure at a price that doesn't require a hedge fund salary.

Here's what the daily output actually looks like for each pick:

 -  Ticker + company name + sector
 -  Action signal: Strong Buy / Buy / Hold / Reduce / Sell
 -  Specific entry price
 -  Target price
 -  Stop-loss level
 -  Conviction score

No narrative. No "we believe the macro tailwinds favor..." Just parameters.

The portfolio analysis layer reads your actual holdings, scores your overall risk level (Low / Moderate / Elevated / High), and generates specific recommendations  -  not generic "diversify more" advice.

It's $29/month. Subscriber dashboard, no ads, no upsells.

Still early  -  11 pages live, backend running daily pick generation and portfolio analysis. Looking for retail investors who want to trade with a system instead of a gut feeling.

What would you want to see in a tool like this that you can't get anywhere at this price point?
